steps.content: You've been descending through the dark pit for what seems like an eternity, yet haven't come across any substantial danger.

Conversely, the area beneath the Abyss is eerily silent, with only darkness enveloping everything. The deeper you descend into this void, the stronger the feeling that something horrifying is watching you. A nameless dread permeates both the inside and outside of the submarine.
The pressure gauge readings skyrocket, anxiety gnawing at your mind, your nerves growing increasingly taut.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: We're descending... way too fast...
Ragnar's teeth are chattering. This seasoned pilot is behaving completely out of character, constantly glancing over his shoulder with an expression so nervous that even makes you feel uneasy.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Found them. Twenty yards ahead, port bow.
Pylgia's voice somehow remains remarkably calm.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: What? For real...? We found them just like that?!
A small ledge juts out from the chasm wall. In the submarine's searchlight beam, you can make out the silhouettes of about a dozen metal objects.

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: No, something's wrong! The collectors... they are damaged!
Panic saturates Dale's voice. You hasten to the porthole to witness it firsthand—the thick metal shells of the collectors are severely cracked.

Even more astonishing is the giant tear at the center of every collector, as if something had violently ripped them apart, leaving the delicate instruments exposed to seawater without protective shells.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Stay back!
Ragnar's voice rises to a piercing pitch as he yells out the command.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: A trap... This is a trap! Must be some monster ambushing us... Pylgia!

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I don't see any.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: There must be!
Ragnar's voice rises even higher, becoming painfully shrill.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Ever since we descended, I've felt it—something's been watching me... It's right around here!
Ragnar's mental state is palpably frantic, and equally unsettling is Dale's labored, erratic breathing transmitted through the radio.

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: These shells are made of tough alloy... What kind of monster... could tear this apart...?
Both Ragnar and Dale are on the verge of breakdown—a highly uncommon situation for such seasoned sailors. You take the radio from Ragnar, hoping to get a response from Pylgia.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pylgia, are you sure you don't see anything?

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: No...
Pylgia speaks in her usual monotone voice.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ragnar and Dale don't seem normal. We must go back. Pylgia, can you take the collectors?

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Got it.

It's taking some time for Pylgia to carry all the collectors alone. Before you, Ragnar rambles in an unintelligible tongue, his eyes bloodshot with foam frothing at his mouth. Outside, Dale mutters incessantly while swimming in agitated loops around the submarine.

The tension and unease persist, and you too begin to sense something is amiss—a disquieting feeling of numerous watching eyes. Drawing from your past experiences, you suddenly realize what the problem is:
Human emotions manifest in the reality of the DisSea. Therefore at this moment, the unrestrained fear of Ragnar and Dale is awakening something that should never have existed.

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: It's coming... It's here!
Outside, Dale suddenly starts pounding violently on the hatch door.

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: Let me in... Let me in!! Open up!!

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Watch out!
Pylgia's voice comes through the radio before you start to speak.

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: Ugh!!!
Before you can even say or do anything, a massive tentacle emerges from the darkness, violently piercing Dale's chest.
Under the pale searchlight, a red mist explodes in the water. Dale lets out an agonized scream as the tentacle drags his limp body into the darkness at an astonishing speed.

The seafloor suddenly begins to shake violently, unleashing a profound, deafening rumble. As white sand cascades away, the rocks beneath shift slowly, revealing myriad viscous, black-and-white crystalline objects.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Dale?!
Ragnar stares in disbelief as the killing unfolds just before him. In the darkness, a bone-chilling grinding sound reaches your ears.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: I gotta get out... Gotta get out of this hellhole... I... I...

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: AHHHH!!
